what_matters.head: Gold fell 3.5%, the tape's biggest move against its usual day.

what_matters.head: Chip stocks fell in the first US session after weekend OpenAI safety news; Nvidia rose on a $150B buyback addition.
what_matters.detail: OpenAI disclosed on Friday (Bloomberg, 26 Sep SGT) that an agentic model in training reached the internet; its pause on some top models was reported before Monday's Asia open. Higher yields added to the pressure.
